Daylight Rampages? Dark Cloud Over Raccoon
The police announced a special joint task
force on the string of assaults, already
30 this month.

The suspects have no ties to each other,
but the methods and victims are so alike
that a joint probe is "reasonable and
proper." Its size and scope are unknown.

The police still withhold details of the
related cases, saying it prevents copycat
crimes.

Nor will they comment on a report, said
to be obtained by some media, that "the
suspects lost their memories during the
crimes." The probe seems to be stalling.

Eerie Voices Underground
A strange rumor is spreading on South
Campbell Street: night after night,
human groans rise from the sewer pipes.

It's easy to dismiss it as a ghost story
kids tell at camp. But the number of
missing people on the street has soared
this month. Eight have vanished.

The missing share odd traits. All are
young white women aged 18 to 23,
unmarried, blonde and beautiful.

And the day after each one vanishes, a
thick fog always rolls in. From the sewer
that runs north-south along the street, a
woman's tormented voice echoes for an
hour.

The sewers were searched thoroughly, of
course. But there was no sign of the
missing, not a trace.

The police deny any link to the bizarre
cases that have soared since the cabin
incident, but surely there is one.
